Figure 2:Overview of SleuthVLM.(a) Once per video, an ASR model transcribes the speech and a forced aligner assigns timestamps to each word, preserving non-speech intervals as gaps.
(b) A VLM gathers evidence by calling tools over the muted video and transcript in a sandbox; only omni reasoning models also have access tolisten_audio.
(c) The model answers once it has sufficient evidence, subject to fixed budgets.
The illustrated trajectory is a real example from Daily-Omni, answered correctly in 13 turns.

Figure 4:Four trajectories of SleuthVLM: (a, b) answered from the transcript and the picture, (c) with theaudio_captiontool, (d) one question with Claude Opus 5.5, a VLM, and Gemini 3.8 Flash, an omni model, as the reasoning model.
Highlighted rows hold the decisive evidence, and the line under a call is the model’s decision;green: transcript,red: picture,blue: audio.
Every step of (a–d) is detailed inSection10.

Figure 5:Step-by-step trajectories answered from the timed transcript. (a) A count at the moment a phrase is said in a 38-minute video. (b) A sound that never appears on screen and is named by the speaker.
Figure 6:Step-by-step trajectories answered from the timed transcript. (a) A gap in the speech that times the music. (b) Lyrics that carry the emotion of a song.
Figure 7:Step-by-step trajectories answered from the timed transcript. (a) A gap that rules out the spoken options. (b) Word times that reveal one sustained voice.
Figure 8:Step-by-step trajectories with theaudio_captiontool. (a) How the music changes. (b) Which instrument drives the rhythm, settled by two differently worded calls.

Figure 9:Step-by-step trajectories with theaudio_captiontool. (a) A non-speech sound that explains the plot. (b) The start of the first music in a 41-minute video, located by the transcript gaps and confirmed by the tool.

Figure 10:The same question in the same harness with two reasoning models. (a) SleuthVLM (Opus 5.5), a VLM, binds the comment to the sentence spoken at that moment in five turns. (b) SleuthVLM (Gemini 3.8 Flash), an omni model, finds the same evidence and loses it over 27 turns.
